context: Interactive rotating globe tech demo showing 30 world cities color-coded by continent with a day/night terminator line, drag-to-rotate interaction, and pulsing city markers
first_impression: Polished dark-themed globe with a cohesive navy-and-forest-green palette and intentional Tol color coding, but simplified hand-drawn land geometry gives it an approximate, cartoonish quality
what_works: The Tol palette is a genuine design choice — not schemeCategory10 — and the dark navy ocean against forest-green land with amber dashed terminator creates real color harmony. Title hierarchy (bold title, muted subtitle, quiet legend) is present and readable.
what_doesnt: Europe city dots (#228833 green) nearly camouflage against the land fill (#1a5c3a dark green) — a legibility failure for one of the six categories. The hand-coded simplified land polygons produce noticeably coarse continent shapes that undercut the otherwise polished feel.
